∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : OracleTemplate.Muon.Public) (L σ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < q.η →
        0 ≤ q.β →
          q.β < 1 →
            1 ≤ q.B →
              1 ≤ q.T →
                ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → ℝ),
                  (∀ (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n), HasGradientAt f (gradient f W) W) →
                    (∀ (W W' : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n),
                        OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f W - gradient f W') ≤
                          L * OracleTemplate.Muon.spectralNorm (W - W')) →
                      BddBelow (Set.range f) →
                        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
                          (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n),
                          LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k s => s k) ↑μ ↑P →
                            LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient
                                (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n) Ω (↑μ) f g σ →
                              (∀ (t : ℕ), Measurable fun s => (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1) ∧
                                (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun s =>
                                        OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm
                                          (gradient f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1))
                                      ↑P) ∧
                                  (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun s => f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1)
                                        ↑P) ∧
                                    1 / ↑q.T *
                                        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range q.T,
                                          ∫ (s : ℕ → Ω),
                                            OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm
                                              (gradient f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s t).2.1) ∂↑P ≤
                                      (∫ (s : ℕ → Ω),
                                                  f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s 0).2.1 -
                                                    f (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g s q.T).2.1 ∂↑P) /
                                                (↑q.T * q.η) +
                                              L * q.η / 2 +
                                            2 * σ * √(↑(min q.m q.n) * (1 - q.β)) / √((1 + q.β) * ↑q.B) +
                                          2 * q.β * σ * √↑(min q.m q.n) / ((1 - q.β) * ↑q.T * √↑q.B) +
                                        2 * q.η * q.β * L / (1 - q.β)
